structure.sql: SELECT c.ordinal_position AS `#`, c.column_name AS column_name, CONCAT(c.column_type, IF(c.srs_id IS NULL, '', CONCAT(' SRID ', c.srs_id))) AS data_type, c.character_set_name AS character_set, c.collation_name AS collation, c.is_nullable AS is_nullable, c.column_default AS column_default, c.extra AS extra, (SELECT CONCAT(k.referenced_table_name, '(', k.referenced_column_name, ')') FROM information_schema.key_column_usage k WHERE k.table_schema=c.table_schema AND k.table_name=c.table_name AND k.column_name=c.column_name AND k.referenced_table_name IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1) AS foreign_key, c.column_comment AS comment FROM information_schema.columns c WHERE c.table_schema='zixma' AND c.table_name='sa_banks' ORDER BY c.ordinal_position;

indexes.sql: SELECT index_name AS index_name, index_type AS index_algorithm, CASE MAX(non_unique) WHEN 0 THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END AS is_unique, GROUP_CONCAT(column_name ORDER BY seq_in_index SEPARATOR ', ') AS column_name FROM information_schema.statistics WHERE table_schema='zixma' AND table_name='sa_banks' GROUP BY index_name, index_type ORDER BY index_name='PRIMARY' DESC, MIN(seq_in_index), index_name;

structure.sql: SELECT a.attnum AS "#", a.attname AS column_name, format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) AS data_type, co.collname AS collation, CASE WHEN a.attnotnull THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END AS is_nullable, pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid) AS column_default, CASE WHEN a.attidentity <> '' THEN 'identity' WHEN a.attgenerated <> '' THEN 'generated' ELSE NULL END AS extra, (SELECT confrelid::regclass::text || '(' || (SELECT attname FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid = con.confrelid AND attnum = con.confkey[array_position(con.conkey, a.attnum)]) || ')' FROM pg_constraint con WHERE con.conrelid = a.attrelid AND con.contype = 'f' AND a.attnum = ANY(con.conkey) LIMIT 1) AS foreign_key, col_description(a.attrelid, a.attnum) AS comment FROM pg_attribute a LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid = a.attrelid AND d.adnum = a.attnum LEFT JOIN pg_collation co ON co.oid = a.attcollation AND a.attcollation <> 0 WHERE a.attrelid = '"public"."sa_banks"'::regclass AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped ORDER BY a.attnum;

indexes.sql: SELECT ic.relname AS index_name, am.amname AS index_algorithm, CASE WHEN i.indisunique THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END AS is_unique, (SELECT string_agg(pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid, k, true), ', ' ORDER BY k) FROM generate_series(1, i.indnkeyatts) k) AS column_name, pg_get_expr(i.indpred, i.indrelid) AS condition, (SELECT CASE c.contype WHEN 'p' THEN 'primary' WHEN 'u' THEN 'unique' WHEN 'x' THEN 'exclusion' END FROM pg_constraint c WHERE c.conindid = i.indexrelid AND c.conrelid = i.indrelid LIMIT 1) AS constraint_type FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class ic ON ic.oid = i.indexrelid JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = ic.relam WHERE i.indrelid = '"public"."sa_banks"'::regclass ORDER BY i.indisprimary DESC, ic.relname;
